run_alphafold3_cli: run the alphafold3 CLI with a checkpoint file to launch the gradio web UI
run_fold_protein: run protein structure prediction with alphafold3 given protein sequence entities
run_fold_complex: run alphafold3 structure prediction for a complex of protein, DNA, RNA, ligands, and ions
build_gradio_app: build a gradio web UI for interactive alphafold3 structure prediction with molecule type selection
delete_cache_files: delete cached prediction output files for a given gradio session hash
